title: La Plata Museum
geometryBasis: The mapped 17-point outer envelope, surviving front projection and University account of the original courts.
sectionBasis: Original photograph published in 1913, museum floor and envelope dimensions and documented classical frontage.
limitations: The building represents the 1912 museum before the library filled one original court. The historic court shapes, roofs, concealed elevations and individual ornaments are approximated.

The original terrain field is preserved. Local Terrarium relief rises behind the frontage and covers some lower rear exterior detail in the terrain view. Precise historic grade and paving are approximate.
The black-and-white original controls architectural forms. The warm exterior palette and roof colors are estimates.
